summary: E2E frontend validation of Milestone 7 (Checkout + Orders + CLICK Mock Payment). All 12 requested scenarios executed successfully against the preview URL. Guest and authenticated checkout flows work end-to-end with mock CLICK payment (SUCCESS/FAILURE/TIMEOUT), server-side totals (UZS 149,000 + 30,000 = 179,000) render correctly, guest token privacy is enforced (tampered/missing token -> confirm-invalid), cart clears on paid and is retained on failure/timeout, saved-address flow for authenticated user works and order snapshot persists, /orders + /orders/:orderNumber render with all required testids, /orders as guest redirects to /login, i18n RU/UZ/ID renders localized copy with no raw keys and money always in UZS, mobile 375 & 768 have zero horizontal overflow, and no non-401 browser console errors were observed.
action_items: Non-blocking: header-cart-count testid is NOT rendered on the mock payment page (/checkout/payment/mock) even when the cart still contains items (verified on failure path). Once user navigates to /cart the badge reappears with correct count and the cart is fully retained. Consider ensuring the header badge is rendered uniformly on the mock payment page for consistency.

Non-blocking: after logging in, the app switched the site locale to the authenticated user's stored preference (Indonesian in this run) which changed number formatting from '179,000' to '179.000' mid-session. All values are still correct UZS integers; just flagging that this can surprise QA. Locale switch is intentional per account preference.
critical_code_review_comments: Server-authoritative totals confirmed on UI: subtotal, shipping (Standard 30,000 default; Express 65,000 option; FREE >= 550,000 threshold visible in banner), and grand total 179,000 all match request spec.
Guest token privacy correctly enforced client-side: tampered token -> confirm-invalid shown, order data never leaks. Stripped token -> confirm-invalid as well.
Idempotency: Place Order button disables while submitting; navigation to /checkout/payment/mock produced exactly one order per flow with a unique MC- number.
Cart clearing rules verified: SUCCESS -> cart empty on /cart and header badge gone; FAILURE and TIMEOUT -> cart retained (item and header badge preserved after navigating back to /cart).
seed_data_creation: Created one address for the demo customer via /account (address-add form) since account had no saved address at test start. Placed several test orders for the demo customer (all Paid mock orders). Guest orders generated for scenarios 1-5 and 10.
context_for_next_testing_agent: M7 is fully green from a UI perspective. Key verified behaviors: (1) POST /checkout returns order + mock payment URL, UI navigates to /checkout/payment/mock?order=MC-...&payment=...&token=...; (2) mock page (mockpay-page/badge/order-number/amount) exposes 3 scenario buttons; (3) SUCCESS -> /order-confirmation?order=MC-...&token=..., cart cleared exactly once; (4) FAILURE -> mockpay-result-failed panel with 'Payment not completed' and mockpay-back-checkout; cart retained; (5) TIMEOUT -> mockpay-result-timeout 'Payment status unknown'; order NOT paid; (6) Order detail testids: order-detail, order-item-BRS-30ML (renders SKU + qty x unit + line total), order-totals, order-grand-total, order-address (shipping snapshot); (7) confirm-view-orders link present on auth confirmation page; (8) Guest /orders -> /login redirect; (9) i18n RU 'Оформление заказа', UZ 'Buyurtma', ID 'Checkout', all money as UZS integer (locale-dependent thousand sep: comma for RU/EN, dot for ID); mock page also localized (RU 'Тестовый платёж CLICK', 'MOCK / РАЗРАБОТКА'); (10) mobile 375 & 768 have zero horizontal overflow on /checkout, /checkout/payment/mock, /order-confirmation. Known non-issues: 401 probes for /api/auth/me for guest sessions (expected); demo customer's /orders list includes prior Cancelled orders from backend tests.
